concepts.meaning: Separates pure routing-link edits from node-operation edits and mixed edits, and records whether the effective connection count and internal node count move together or independently.
Contrasts the longest internal-node path before and after the edit, distinguishing edits that change the deepest route from those that leave depth unchanged.
Relates change in the minimum internal-node route to change in total effective path multiplicity, separating shortcut-like depth shifts from path-count changes.
Background fan-out and fan-in structure of the parent, indicating whether edited slots sit in a branching or merging region of the effective graph.
Locates edited slots relative to parent and child paths: whether all, some, or no paths are touched, and whether two edited slots share a path before or after.
Operation context of the parent graph by operation type, distinguishing edits made in conv3x3-rich, conv1x1-rich, or pooling-rich backgrounds.
Untouched operation context retained in both graphs, separating edits that preserve most of the operation mixture from those that alter it.
Effective internal node count before and after, distinguishing node-preserving edits from node-removing or node-adding structural changes.
Parent effective path multiplicity together with its change, separating edits that add, remove, or preserve input-output routes.
Joint routing change: whether effective connection count and minimum internal-node route length move in the same or opposite directions.
For two-slot edits, whether the slots co-occur on a parent path, a child path, or neither, and whether the edit is link-only, node-only, or mixed.
Parent topology profile combining deepest internal route with branching and merging vertices, giving structural context for where an edit lands.
